item.title: N-methylaniline exposure likely caused methemoglobinemia in maritime migration
item.description: In a case series of severe acquired methemoglobinemia among migrants to Italy, prolonged skin exposure to fuel-contaminated seawater was identified as the likely cause.

item.title: Historical redlining linked to lower breast cancer screening in urban areas
item.description: In a retrospective cohort study, historically redlined grade C and D Census tracts had lower breast cancer screening rates than grade A tracts.

item.title: 5x-multiplier algorithm cuts opioids prescribed at discharge
item.description: The 5x-multiplier approach reduced opioid prescribing at discharge compared to the 3-tier model after intra-abdominal cancer surgery.

item.title: Jerina Gani, MD, MPH, on primary care burnout: a KevinMD spotlight
item.description: Jerina Gani, MD, MPH is a primary care physician in Boston, trained in internal medicine, with about twenty years in practice.
